claim_boundary: Pinned sources, archives, controls, and preregistered oracles establish execution readiness only. Matched allocator arms, compiler/runtime coverage, raw artifacts, and repeated outcomes remain required for efficacy claims.

execution_policy.build: Fetch locked dependencies first, then compile with network disabled in a disposable container.
execution_policy.run: Use a read-only disposable container with no network, no added capabilities, no-new-privileges, an unprivileged UID, CPU/memory/PID limits, and a TERM-to-KILL timeout with host-side forced cleanup.
